what: Round 2 of the tool-description work, targeted at Glama's published rubric using GLAMA'S OWN per-tool scores rather than a local heuristic.

key_mechanism_finding.claim: Glama's /mcp/connectors pages score the HOSTED endpoint's tool descriptions, not the descriptions in packages/mcp-license.
key_mechanism_finding.evidence: glama.ai/mcp/connectors/io.github.theluckystrike/amortization renders license_activate as 'Turn Pro on for this hosted connection using a key from checkout...', which is the string in remote/src/shims/license.ts:259-261, NOT the string in packages/mcp-license/src/index.ts:215. The same page renders loan_journal byte-identical to servers/amortization/src/index.ts, so ordinary tools DO flow from servers/*/src through remote/build-vendor.mjs.
key_mechanism_finding.consequence: The 31x shared-description lever for the connector surface lives in remote/src/shims/license.ts. packages/mcp-license drives the /mcp/servers surface only, where license_activate already scores 4.3-4.4 and needs no work.

score_stamp_question.asked: Round 1 rewrote the two shared licence descriptions; Glama showed the new text but the score stamp still read 2026-09-08. Has it re-scored?
score_stamp_question.answer: Yes for per-tool scores, no for the aggregate. Every one of the 25 connectors still stamps 'Scored 2026-09-08' and still publishes the 2026-09-08 TDQS number, but the per-tool table has been recomputed: license_activate now scores 3.8 on 25 of 25 connectors (round 2 measured min 1.4, max 3.1, mean 2.26). The published TDQS is a cached aggregate; the rubric table underneath it is fresh.

surface_note: A blind buyer-intent measurement cited /mcp/servers URLs 6 times and /mcp/connectors 0 times. Both surfaces use the identical rubric and share these tool definitions, so this work lands on both; but see docs/TOOL_QUALITY_R2.md section 6 for why the connector LISTING cannot be climbed with score.
formula: TDQS = 0.6*mean(tool scores) + 0.4*min(tool scores); overall = 0.7*TDQS + 0.3*mean(4 coherence dimensions)

rewrites.after: Turn Pro on for this connection with key, an MCPL1.<payload>.<signature> issued at checkout for this server or the bundle. Data under your token stays; a wrong or expired key changes nothing. license_status confirms it.
rewrites.before: Turn Pro on for this hosted connection using a key from checkout, keeping the data already stored under your current token. Pass key as MCPL1.<payload>.<signature>. A wrong or expired key changes nothing.
rewrites.multiplier: 25 of 25 connectors (the vendored hosted licence shim is registered by every hosted server)

rewrites.before: Create a quote and return its Q number and totals. unit_price is in MAJOR units; currency, VAT and the issuer come from the shared profile. It expires by itself after validity_days. Free: 5 open quotes.
rewrites.after: Store a quote for client from items and return its Q number, VAT and totals. unit_price is in MAJOR units; currency, VAT and issuer come from the shared profile. A duplicate of an open quote is refused. Free: 5 open.

rewrites.before: List the ledger lines for a period, filtered by account, source server or document id, and date. Each line carries its debit, credit and bank_ref, the same field the Pro CSV lays out as a column. Free and unlimited.
rewrites.after: List the ledger lines for a period, filtered by account, source server, source_id or date; each carries its debit, credit and bank_ref, with the totals of the rows returned. Filtered totals do not balance. Free.

rewrites.before: List what a month leaves unposted or inconsistent, with its trial balance, then record the close as a snapshot; a later call names any drift. dry_run reports without writing. Pro.
rewrites.after: List what a month leaves unposted or unbalanced, with its trial balance and bank reconciliation, then store the close as a snapshot; a later call names any drift against it. dry_run writes nothing. Pro.

rewrites.before: Return the exact expense_add arguments for a saved trip, one payload per currency, ready to pass to the expense-tracker server. It writes nothing itself: see the note in the answer. Pro.
rewrites.after: Return the exact expense_add arguments for a saved trip: one payload for subsistence and, with split_lodging, one for lodging. It writes nothing in the expense-tracker server; only mark_exported changes this trip. Pro.

rewrites.before: Delete one saved trip that has not been exported and has no expense booked against it, and free the free-tier slot it held that month. A trip with a dependent is refused, named. Free and unlimited.
rewrites.after: Delete one saved trip and free the free-tier slot it held that month. A trip that has been exported or has an expense booked against it is refused with the blocker named, and nothing is written. Free and unlimited.

rewrites.before: Calculate a trip and save it under a name, with the traveller taken from the shared business profile. Returns the TRIP-YYYY-NNNN id. Free tier: 5 trips a calendar month.
rewrites.after: Calculate a trip and save it under a name, traveller taken from the shared business profile; returns the TRIP-YYYY-NNNN id. An identical record is refused and named, spending no slot. Free: 5 trips a calendar month.

rewrites.before: The audit log for one schedule, oldest first: period, invoice number, dates, amount, PDF path, and whether that invoice is unpaid, paid, skipped or has since been deleted. Pro.
rewrites.after: The audit log for one schedule id, oldest first: period, invoice number, issue and due dates, amount, PDF path, and whether that invoice is unpaid, paid, skipped or since deleted. schedule_list finds the id. Pro.

rewrites.before: Change a schedule's client, items, currency, cadence, dates, due days, notes or auto_generate flag. Periods already invoiced are never re-issued, so changing the amount affects future invoices only.
rewrites.after: Change one schedule by id: client, items, currency, cadence, dates, due_days, notes or auto_generate. Only the fields you pass change. Periods already invoiced are never re-issued, so a new amount applies to future ones.

rewrites.before: Turn tracked billable time into invoice line items for one project or client: hours, hourly rate, amount per task and the total, in the currency the work was logged in (EUR 225.00, not $225.00).
rewrites.after: Turn tracked billable time into invoice lines for one project: hours, hourly rate, amount per task and the total, one line per rate so two rates never average. Hours already marked billed are left out. Free: last 7 days.

rewrites.before: Return the double entry for one payment period or one month: debit interest expense and loan liability, credit cash, in the cash book's account names, with an expense_add-ready payload. Pro.
rewrites.after: Return the double entry for one payment period or month: debit interest expense and loan liability, credit cash, in the cash book's account names, with an expense_add-ready payload. Give period or month, not both. Pro.

rewrites.before: List the register with terms, level payment, effective annual rate and, at a date, periods paid, balance outstanding, interest to date and the next payment, totalled per currency. Free and unlimited.
rewrites.after: List the register with terms, level payment, effective annual rate and, at as_of, periods paid, balance outstanding, interest to date and the next payment, totalled per currency. Free; loans_report is the Pro roll-up.

rewrites.before: The debt at a date: per loan what is outstanding, whether it is settled, the next payment, and the interest and principal charged in a year, then totals per currency. It is the contractual balance. Pro.
rewrites.after: The debt at as_of: per loan what is outstanding, whether it is settled, the next payment, and the interest and principal charged in a year, then totals per currency. Contractual balance, not cash paid. Pro.

rewrites.before: For one year: net book value by category, scheme and currency at a date, the year's depreciation charge per currency, and every disposal with its gain or loss. Pro; asset_list and asset_schedule are free.
rewrites.after: For one year: net book value by category, scheme and currency at as_of, the year's depreciation charge per currency, and every disposal with its gain or loss. Pro; asset_list and asset_schedule are free per-asset views.

rewrites.before: Raise a purchase order to a supplier and return its PO number. unit_price is in MAJOR units; currency, VAT and the buyer block come from the shared profile. Free: 5 documents a calendar month.
rewrites.after: Raise a purchase order to a supplier from items and return its PO number and totals. unit_price is in MAJOR units; currency, VAT and the buyer block come from the shared profile. Free: 5 documents a calendar month.

rewrites.before: Call this tool to write the resume as semantic HTML with a print stylesheet and return the path; print it to PDF from a browser. Bullets are trimmed to fit max_pages. Free and unlimited.
rewrites.after: Call this tool to write the resume as semantic HTML with a print stylesheet and return where it went; print it to PDF from a browser, because there is no doc_to_pdf here. Bullets are trimmed to fit max_pages. Free.

rewrites.before: Report the catalogue: how many SKUs there are, how many price rows are in force today, which rows a later row already replaces, and which SKUs carry no price in the profile's default currency. Pro.
rewrites.after: Report the catalogue as at date: how many SKUs there are, how many price rows are in force, which rows a later row already replaces, and which SKUs carry no price in the profile's default currency. Reads only. Pro.

rewrites.before: Add a catalogue line or reprice one: a code, a name, a unit, an optional VAT rate, and a price in minor units for one currency, tier and valid-from date. Free tier: 25 SKUs.
rewrites.after: Add a catalogue line or reprice one: a code, a name, a unit, an optional VAT rate, and price_minor in whole minor units for one currency, tier and valid_from. A repriced line keeps its old rows. Free: 25 SKUs, one tier.

rewrites.before: Answer "how much of theirs am I holding?" for one client or for everyone: received, applied to invoices, refunded and still held, one row per currency, never added across currencies.
rewrites.after: Answer "how much of theirs am I holding?" for one client or everyone: received, applied to invoices, refunded and still held, one row per currency, never added across them. Reads only; deposit_list shows each deposit.

rewrites.before: Write a payment chaser at level 1 friendly, 2 firm or 3 final demand: every OVERDUE invoice with its age, the total and your bank details. Nothing overdue is refused. No interest is stated. Level 3 is Pro.
rewrites.after: Write a payment chaser at level 1 friendly, 2 firm or 3 final demand: every OVERDUE invoice with its age, the total and your bank details. Refused if nothing is overdue. No interest is stated. Level 3 is Pro.

rewrites.before: Call this tool to resize every image into out_dir, keeping aspect ratio, named <name>-<W>x<H>.<ext>. One of width/height lets the other follow; with both, each fits inside the box. Free: 5 files/call, up to 4 MP.
rewrites.after: Call this tool to resize every image in paths at once, keeping aspect ratio, each named <name>-<W>x<H>.<ext>. One of width/height lets the other follow; with both, each fits inside the box. Free: 5 files a call, 4 MP.

rewrites.before: Convert a time from one place to others. The input time is read as wall-clock time in from_zone unless it carries an offset or a trailing Z. Accepts '2026-09-10 15:00', an ISO timestamp, or a phrase like '3pm tomorrow'.
rewrites.after: Convert one time from from_zone into every zone in to_zones, marking any day change, plus the UTC instant. The time is wall-clock in from_zone unless it carries an offset or a trailing Z. '3pm tomorrow' works.

rewrites.before: Call this tool to turn markdown into a .docx and return the path with a count of blocks by type. Headings, lists, GFM tables and code fences are honoured. An existing file is kept unless overwrite.
rewrites.after: Call this tool to turn markdown into a .docx, returning the file and a count of blocks by type. Headings, lists, GFM tables and code fences are honoured. Empty markdown is refused, and so is overwriting without the flag.

rewrites.before: Store a client so invoices can refer to them by name. Re-adding the same name updates the stored details; a record identical to one already stored is refused, naming the id that holds it.
rewrites.after: Store a client so invoice_create can refer to them by name. Re-adding the same name updates the stored address, email and VAT id; a record identical to a stored one is refused, naming the id that already holds it.

rewrites.before: Delete one image stored for your token, uploaded or generated.
rewrites.after: Delete one image stored for your token, uploaded or generated: name is the name it is stored under. image_files lists them. A name nothing is stored under is refused and nothing is deleted.

rewrites.before: Delete one document uploaded for your token.
rewrites.after: Delete one document uploaded for your token: name is the name it was uploaded under, without .docx. doc_files lists them. A name nothing is stored under is refused and nothing is deleted.

servers_surface_count_correction.why: scripts/glama-watch.mjs pageExists() uses HEAD /mcp/servers/<owner>/<repo> with a negative control on the badge route only. The page route flaps: a deliberately nonexistent repo returned 404,200,404,404,404 over five consecutive requests.
servers_surface_count_correction.authoritative: Glama sitemap https://glama.ai/sitemaps/mcp-servers/{1..9}.xml, 85,082 URLs, positive control = the known-listed repo is present
servers_surface_count_correction.true_count: 2 of 34 mirrors (3 repos overall), up from 1 at loop 31
servers_surface_count_correction.action: replace pageExists() with the 9-page sitemap sweep; every listed count in today data/glama_watch.json is inflated; the per-connector rubric data in the same file is unaffected

connector_page_reader_diff.connector_page_prose: one sentence, from server.json.description; no README, no install commands, no schema/source tabs (true of every connector, not just ours)
connector_page_reader_diff.server_page_prose: full README rendered inline plus Schema, Source, Score tabs, install commands, Maintenance panel
connector_page_reader_diff.conclusion: Score does not rank a row on the connector listing. It changes what a reader sees once on the page. Two listing levers we do control and do not use: GitHub Stars (0 everywhere) and Date Updated (a registry version publish).

boundary_note: Descriptions only were edited in remote/src/shims/license.ts, image-upload.ts and docx-upload.ts (A4 files). No logic touched. packages/mcp-license was read but NOT modified: its license_activate already scores 4.3-4.4 on the surface that reads it.

verification.npm_test_baseline: 34 suites, 1574 tests, 1563 pass, 0 fail, 0 not ok
